meta.notes: Personal n8n only (market-alerts/deploy, container n8n-personal). Do not import this into the ChartSignl n8n service. Credentials: Postgres transcripts_n8n; Slack Bot; Supadata API Key as Header Auth name x-api-key (required); TranscriptAPI Bearer is optional; Google Drive OAuth (drive.file). No YouTube Data API key. No secrets in this file. Config is read from the container environment ($env), not n8n Variables: TRANSCRIPT_TIMEZONE, TRANSCRIPT_PROVIDER, MONTHLY_TRANSCRIPT_LIMIT, SLACK_ALERT_CHANNEL, HEALTHCHECK_TRANSCRIPTS_URL. YouTube items come from yt-dlp --flat-playlist on the channel /videos tab. Channel ids are hard-coded in transcripts/sources.json. A non-zero yt-dlp exit or zero videos fails the source. Provider endpoints checked 2026-11-04. Supadata GET https://api.supadata.ai/v1/transcript mode=native. TranscriptAPI GET https://transcriptapi.com/api/v2/youtube/transcript. An empty TranscriptAPI credential is skipped. yt-dlp is pinned to 2026.10.26 in the personal image. Keep the Trading Transcripts Drive folder unshared. Set the error workflow to Trading Transcripts — Error Handler after import.
